title: Fire-Boltt Ninja X Ring Smart Watch with 1.96” Large Display, Bluetooth Calling, Wireless Charging, AI Voice Assistant, 500+ Watch Faces, Health Suite, Smart Watch for Man & Woman
bullets: LARGE 1.96” IPS DISPLAY WITH VIBRANT VISUALS: Experience immersive clarity with a 1.96” IPS full-touch display featuring 2.5D curved glass and 240x296 resolution, with premium smart watch for men enjoy vibrant colors, smooth scrolling, and intuitive multi-touch navigation.

BLUETOOTH CALLING & AI VOICE ASSISTANT FOR HANDS-FREE CONTROL: Make and receive calls directly from your wrist with stable BT 3.0 + 5.1 connectivity. Use the built-in AI voice assistant to set reminders, play music with smart watch for women or check the weather—all without touching your phone.

WIRELESS CHARGING WITH LONG-LASTING BATTERY: Charge with ease using wireless technology and enjoy up to 7 days of usage on a single charge. The 200mAh battery ensures reliable power whether you're working out or on the go.

ALWAYS-ON DISPLAY FOR INSTANT GLANCEABLE INFO: Stay informed without lifting your wrist—Always-On Display keeps key metrics and time visible at all times, adding both convenience and a premium look to your daily wear.

GAMES, WATCH FACES & SMART UTILITIES FOR DAILY USE: Customize your smartwatch with 500+ cloud and photo watch faces, play built-in puzzle games, and access smart tools like calculator, flashlight, stopwatch, alarm, and weather updates.
